lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Kell Village is not the village you left. There is a memorial by the gate, a wall of names from a winter in 2148, and a line of hand-forged blades hung above it. The market is louder. Nobody looks at the sky.

lines.speaker: dax
lines.text: They remember it. They remember us. I am not sure I like being a legend, Sister.

lines.speaker: wren
lines.text: You are not a legend. You are a wall of names that a town chose to keep. That is better.
